description: This file defines the BufferStream class, which implements the StreamInterface to handle buffering of data streams in memory. It provides methods for reading, writing, and managing an in-memory buffer, as well as retrieving metadata such as the high water mark.

classes.name: BufferStream
classes.description: A class implementing a buffer stream that can be written to and read from, supporting stream interface methods and managing an internal buffer with a high water mark.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BufferStream with an optional high water mark value (default 16384).

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the buffer as a string.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the current buffer contents.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Closes the buffer and detaches the stream (effectively noop in this implementation).

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the buffer.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is readable (always true).

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is writable (always true).

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is not seekable (always false).

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the position to the beginning (calls seek with 0).

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws exception as seeking is unsupported.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is at end (empty).

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Throws exception as position cannot be determined.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified length of data from the buffer, removing it.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer, returning false if the high water mark is exceeded.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata, specifically the high water mark if requested.
